mapper.sql: id, name, price, stock, version, create_at, update_at, created_by, updated_by, is_delete
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products.products (id, name, price, stock, version, create_at, update_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, 0, #{createAt}, #{updateAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM products.products WHERE id = #{id} AND is_delete = false
SELECT FROM products.products WHERE is_delete = false AND id IN #{id}
